customManagers.description: The manager default in cmd/main.go must name the same digest-pinned busybox as the chart's secure.probeImage (TestDefaultProbeImageMatchesChartValue fails the build when they drift); the built-in helm-values manager already owns the chart side, this moves the Go side in the same PR
Every actions/setup-go go-version pin must name the same Go as .mise/config.toml; the built-in mise manager owns that side (same datasource and depName), this moves the workflow side into the same PR

packageRules.description: One PR per Go toolchain bump: mise's go tool (built-in mise manager), the workflow go-version pins (custom manager above), and the Dockerfile's golang base images (built-in docker manager) all move together
Keep GitHub Actions pinned to readable semver tags, not SHA digests (overrides the shared preset's pinDigests rule)
